title: Oaty Nutty Uruguayan Oat Bake
description: A nutty and aerated Uruguayan dish featuring chocolate chips, perfect for meal prep, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients. This bake is a delicious and healthy option for a snack or dessert.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the rolled oats, chopped walnuts, and dark chocolate chips.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut oil, honey, vanilla extract, salt, and turmeric.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until everything is well combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x9 inch baking dish and smooth out the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
Remove the bake from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Use a spatula to deglaze the bottom of the baking dish and release the bake.
Let the bake cool completely before cutting into bars and serving.
